summary: <cite index="12-2,12-3">US stock futures traded mixed on Monday ahead of an action-packed week featuring Nvidia earnings and the Federal Reserve's Jackson Hole Symposium, with the Trump administration also expected to announce details of new economic sanctions against Iran.</cite> <cite index="12-4">Futures on the S&P 500 slipped 0.2% while Nasdaq Composite futures fell 0.7% after the major indexes posted weekly declines.</cite> Asian markets struggled overnight, with <cite index="10-4">Samsung Electronics slumping over 6% after announcing plans to return as much as 110 trillion won ($80 billion) to investors this year.</cite> Meanwhile, crypto markets remained buoyant after last week's Treasury-driven rally, with <cite index="31-18,31-19,31-20">US spot Bitcoin ETFs recording $600 million in net inflows on August 20, following inflows of $297.5 million on August 17, $186.4 million on August 18, and $517 million on August 19.</cite> <cite index="14-4,14-9">The yield on the U.S. 30-year Treasury surged to multi-decade highs this week, and refused to fall even after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent made the surprise decision to at least double buybacks of long-dated bonds starting in September.</cite> <cite index="14-10">That heightens the importance of what Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh might say this week at Jackson Hole to calm bond investors.</cite>

signals.title: Samsung shareholder return plan triggers Asia tech selloff
signals.desc: <cite index="10-4">Samsung Electronics slumped over 6% after announcing plans to return $80 billion to investors, dragging the Kospi Index down 1.4% and pressuring memory chip stocks globally.</cite>

signals.title: 30-year Treasury yields hit multi-decade highs despite buyback pledge
signals.desc: <cite index="14-4,14-9">The U.S. 30-year Treasury yield surged to multi-decade highs and refused to fall even after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent doubled long-dated bond buybacks, signaling persistent fiscal and inflation concerns.</cite>

signals.title: Fed Chair Warsh faces Jackson Hole debut amid bond market turmoil
signals.desc: <cite index="14-10,14-11">Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at Jackson Hole this week will be critical to calm bond investors, given the newly-installed Fed leader's tight-lipped approach after July's hawkish three-member dissent.</cite>

signals.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows surge to $600M as institutional bid returns
signals.desc: <cite index="31-18,31-19">US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $600 million in net inflows on August 20, bigger than previous sessions and extending the recent run of positive flows after brief weakness mid-month.</cite>

signals.title: Trump administration prepares Iran sanctions announcement
signals.desc: <cite index="12-3">The Trump administration is expected to announce details of new economic sanctions against Iran, adding geopolitical uncertainty ahead of Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole.</cite>

verdict: Markets face a critical week with Nvidia earnings, Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut, and persistent bond market stress creating a volatile backdrop for risk assets.
